input.rationale: Straightforward property damage claim: wind caused physical damage to the insured structure (roof shingles on back porch overhang). No third-party involvement, no theft, no vehicle involved. Covered under homeowners property_damage coverage.
Estimated loss of $400 is well below the $5,000 low-severity threshold. No water intrusion, no structural risk, no injuries. Simple, localized repair scope with straightforward roofer estimate.

input.claim_summary: Jordan Lee (POL-1006) filed a low-severity property damage claim for wind damage to roof shingles on the back porch overhang. Four shingles were blown off during a windstorm last weekend. No water intrusion reported. Estimated repair cost: $400. Policy has $2,500 deductible and $1,000,000 coverage limit. Claim is straightforward and ready for adjuster assignment.
